test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the figure from among the given options that can logically replace the question mark (?) in the following series. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ac60ddfda738c81ed21b7fca28f8b90bcdb9ba319d1eade5e08999d0f3bafc0.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• Letters/Symbols are shifting in clockwise direction from right-top corner to left-top corner. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83d3228d7b207f1e56760718c33184cb86f6756625582bd31a83d0d5f4a5d97a.png] 
 
• Left-top letter shifts in middle and middle symbol shifts in right-top corner.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
